items.title: ‘Crypto Hurdle’ Solved: SoFi Is First Bank Deploying Stablecoin Settlement Across Mastercard Network
items.summary: SoFi just quietly moved its entire card program onto a blockchain that merchants never have to touch, and the four obstacles that killed crypto payments at retail for a decade may have all vanished at once.

items.title: What Does Mastercard (MA) Signal With Its AI Payments And Biometric Push?
items.summary: Mastercard (NYSE: MA) is pushing into AI-powered agentic commerce, biometric payments and secure digital identity across several new initiatives. The company is working with Google Pay in India on expanded biometric authentication for retail payments using device-level identity checks. items.title: How SoFi Is Turning Its Consumer App Into A Stablecoin Proving Ground
items.summary: SoFi Technologies (SOFI) and Mastercard on Tuesday said their stablecoin partnership is fully operational and handling real transactions. SoFi stock climbed on the news. Under the partnership, SoFi's debit and credit card program with more than $25 billion in annualized volume has shifted to Mastercard's payment network using its bank-issued stablecoin. items.title: Merchants call card-fee pact unconstitutional
items.summary: Walmart and other retailers argue that forcing them to stay in a swipe-fee settlement class violates their due process rights.

items.title: SoFi Shares Rise 3% as Bank Launches Stablecoin Settlement on Mastercard Network
items.summary: SoFi Technologies (NASDAQ:SOFI) shares gained 3% on Tuesday after the company announced that SoFi Bank had become the first nationally chartered US bank to introduce live stablecoin settlement across Mastercard’s global payments network. The bank is migrating its entire debit and credit card programme to blockchain-based settlement using SoFiUSD, its US dollar-backed stablecoin.

items.title: SOFI Stock Rises After $25B Card Program Moves To Stablecoin Settlement On Mastercard Network
items.summary: SoFi and Mastercard are exploring additional SoFiUSD use cases, including cross-border payments and remittances.
